hypotheses: In the loop list, the evaluate loop is one row per evaluate run still going: the task and the model, what the run measures as what is to be achieved, the round it is at of the rounds asked, the problems it filed, and what is left. A run that stopped on a held merge says why. A run that ended is not listed; its score stays in its run folder.

given iaso evaluate simple with two fix rounds asked, in its first fix round, when the loops are listed, then its row reads simple, the model, round 1 of 2, the problems filed so far, and the fix round and the rerun as left
given an evaluate run stopped because the merge of a fix is held, when the loops are listed, then its row says it stopped and why
given an evaluate run that ended with its score written, when the loops are listed, then it is not listed
